contexts.text: As by islands are signified the things which are more remote, Tharshish, Pul, Lud, Tubal, and Javan, by whom are signified external worships, are called isles ().

The sons of Shem... Lud... () = the things which are of wisdom... Lud, etc. were so many nations, by whom are signified the things which are of wisdom... by Lud, the Knowledges of truth. AC 1227. AC 1231, Explained, Illustrated.
Lud and also Put () = those who are in Knowledges. References.
